phase_name: Typed Authority Model Production Consumption Contract Independent Verification
summary: Independent-verification-only phase. Re-derived and adversarially verified TAMPC-001 v1.0 (docs/contracts/TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT.md) from primary sources -- the frozen contract text, the live Stage 3 record schemas and packaged manifest.json, the offline pcae.schema_runtime API, the pcae.cltr.authority typed models, the Phase 137E prototype, TAMC-001 v1.0, and live repository/runtime state -- without accepting the Phase 137H report, its requirement inventory, its mapping tables, or its conclusions as an oracle. Fresh independent scanners (not reused from prior phases) confirmed exactly 178 unique, strictly sequential TAMPC-REQ-### requirements (1-178) with no gaps/duplicates/undefined references; exactly one production consumer in scope; sixteen aligned record families reconstructed independently from the records directory, manifest.json (records/ filter), and the prototype _MODEL_BY_FAMILY, with zero manifest-family duplication; explicit manifest one-entry-per-family enforcement (TAMPC-REQ-058/059/108) resolving Phase 137F NB-2; truthful observation-immutability claims including the honestly classified residual object.__setattr__ limitation (not falsely claimed defeated); complete TAMC-001 (76-requirement) traceability; and a deterministic failure-precedence/exit-code/side-effect/security contract. Verified cltr_cutover_root() resolves via importlib.resources with no network access and no caller-supplied path, and that every schema-runtime/authority/core module and symbol the contract names exists with the referenced shape (including parse_strict_json's require_top_level_object param, max_depth=200, and DEFAULT_MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 5 MiB), and that the const:false is_authoritative provenance-forgery constraint is live in shared/limitations.schema.json. One NON-BLOCKING documentation defect was found and repaired documentation-only: TAMPC-REQ-058's incorrect cross-reference (Section 22, TAMPC-REQ-084) -- Section 22 is Security and REQ-084 is Provenance, neither relating to manifest_entry_missing/NB-2 -- was corrected to (Section 17, TAMPC-REQ-108). No requirement was added, deleted, renumbered, or reused; count remains 178, strictly sequential. No Blocking finding remained. Verdict: VERIFIED AFTER REPAIR. No production code, prototype, Stage 3 schema/model/registry/manifest, TAMC-001, or TAMP-001 file was created or modified. Runtime unchanged throughout: Observed / observe / unavailable. Full report in docs/PHASE_137I_TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
